description: This file defines the CompressedDData class, which provides access to distributed data of compressed topics within an Akka actor system. It includes methods to instantiate the data handler, obtain readers and writers, and create subscriptions. It also contains an abstract provider class for configuration extension.

classes.name: CompressedDData
classes.description: Provides access to distributed data for compressed topics, including methods to get readers, writers, and manage subscriptions.

classes.name: CompressedDData.Provider
classes.description: Abstract extension provider class for distributed data configuration, to be implemented by users.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to instantiate CompressedDData with either an actor system and provider or an existing handler.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns a reader for compressed data.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a writer for compressed data.

methods.name: createSubscriptions
methods.description: Creates subscriptions for compressed data updates.
